Risk Statement: Risk of system unavailability, degraded performance, or failure of chatbot infrastructure (Teams, SharePoint, Azure OpenAI) impacting service delivery
Mitigating Actions / Controls: High availability architecture across O365 and Azure stack; DR and backup mechanisms; Monitoring via logs (Splunk, conversation logs); Controlled deployments and updates; Performance monitoring and alerting
Control Description: The AYANA chatbot is deployed on a resilient Microsoft stack (Teams, SharePoint, Azure OpenAI) with logging and monitoring in place. System performance and failures are proactively managed through alerts, logging, and recovery mechanisms to ensure continuity of service.

Risk Statement: Risk of inaccurate, inconsistent, or misleading responses generated by the AI model (LLM) leading to incorrect guidance to employees
Mitigating Actions / Controls: Responses grounded in approved P&C policies; Controlled knowledge base (SharePoint); Model constrained to internal use case; Ongoing testing and refinement of responses; Human escalation path (users can contact P&C if dissatisfied)
Control Description: The chatbot uses a controlled knowledge base of approved P&C policies and does not operate autonomously beyond that scope. Users can escalate queries to P&C if responses are insufficient, reducing reliance on AI-only outcomes.

Risk Statement: Risk arising from inadequate user understanding, misuse of the chatbot, or insufficient capability to manage and maintain the platform
Mitigating Actions / Controls: Training for employees on usage and limitations; Clear guidance on when to escalate to P&C; Defined ownership (Product Owner, Governance Lead, Engineering Lead); Controlled access via Teams authentication; Reduced dependency on limited P&C resources
Control Description: The solution reduces reliance on limited P&C personnel by automating responses while ensuring that users are trained and can escalate queries when needed. Defined roles and governance structures ensure proper management of the platform.

Risk Statement: Risk of inappropriate use of chatbot outputs, misinterpretation of responses, or poor user behaviour leading to incorrect employee actions or poor outcomes
Mitigating Actions / Controls: Standardized responses from approved policies; Controlled tone and messaging aligned to P&C standards; Internal-only usage (no client exposure); Clear positioning as informational tool only; Escalation to P&C for complex queries
Control Description: The chatbot delivers consistent, policy-based responses, minimizing misinterpretation and conduct issues. As an internal tool with no external exposure, the risk of customer harm or regulatory misconduct is significantly reduced.
